summary.text: Marina Franco is the Democratic candidate for South Carolina House of Representatives District 29 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Dennis Moss (R).
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working as a caregiver, and in a Ballotpedia survey she described herself as a mother, immigrant and community advocate.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Marina Franco listed her campaign messages as lowering prescription drug costs and expanding health care access, especially in rural communities, supporting teachers and public schools including technical training, and lowering the cost of living by addressing housing costs and supporting small businesses.
She named education, affordability and public safety as the policy areas she is most passionate about.
